questionEn: Mark the exact description for "acid in school definition"?
questionUz: "Maktab ta'rifidagi kislota" ning aniq tavsifini belgilang?
choicesEn: A complex substance that forms H⁺ (H₃O⁺) ions in an aqueous solution
choicesUz: Suvli eritmada H⁺ (H₃O⁺) ionlarini hosil qiluvchi murakkab modda.
explanationEn: Acids produce hydrogen ions in water.
explanationUz: Kislotalar suvda vodorod ionlarini hosil qiladi.
